answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique classic motorcycle rally entry with owners club attestation. It rests on a rally entry the owners club recorded under one machine, which gives every honest agent a canyon that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the horizon compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the mesa is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
